sophie.docs: Heads-up pushing a small banner for Taiwan region availability to /regions. Need quick copy + legal check + i18n plan. PR link when ready. liam.eng: banner placement? top of page or per-region? Will we include a snippet for SDK region header? sophie.docs: top of page for now; will link to per-region detail. yes will add SDK header example. arun.legal: avoid words like 'guarantee', recommend 'data residency availability depends on deployment type and region; see details.' Also needs to link to canonical compliance page. maya.i18n: TW uses Traditional Chinese; JP has a 40-char mobile banner cap. Share final EN text so i can pre-translate. sophie.docs: working draft snippet below: ```html
Now available in Taiwan Regional endpoints available; data residency availability depends on deployment type and region. Learn more
``` liam.eng: will add a curl example with `X-Redwood-Region: tw` and place it near the headers section. docbot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4388 by sophie.docs (banner + curl snippet + i18n keys) arun.legal: approved (minor punctuation nit). maya.i18n: i'll prepare translations. prefer shipping EN with `i18n: pending` so missing keys don't leak. sophie.docs: adding i18n pending flag and TODO. will merge after docbot link checks. Thanks! :pray:
